turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
rn.

Normal returns aren’t accepted because all sales are final. A damaged item may qualify under the Standard Warranty when reported within 30 days of delivery. Please provide:

Your order number
A clear photo or video of the damage
A description of the issue

If the same item is available, a replacement may be provided. If it’s unavailable, store credit for the amount paid is issued. Refunds aren’t offered for warranty claims. Free and promotional items may have different compensation rules 💖

turns.q: Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?
turns.replyTail: If your damaged-item claim is approved for a replacement, you won’t need to return the original item, so there’s no return shipping to pay. Please include a clear photo or video with your claim so it can be reviewed 💖

turns.q: How long does the replacement take?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks for reaching out to us. Once your replacement is approved and created, it’s sent by standard shipping only. Please allow about 1–2 business days for dispatch, then:

United States or Canada: typically 3–7 business days in transit
Other international destinations: typically 14–20 business days in transit

Expedited or overnight shipping isn’t available for replacements, and these timeframes are estimates 💖

turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks for reaching out to us. If more than one item is damaged, include each affected item in the same claim with a clear photo or video and a short description of each issue.

The approved resolution applies to the whole claim: it will be either replacements for all affected items or store credit for all of them. We don’t split the claim between replacements and credit. If any affected item is out of stock, store credit is issued instead 💖

turns.q: What if the replacement is also damaged?
turns.replyTail: Thanks for reaching out to us. If a replacement also arrives damaged, please submit a new claim with a clear photo or video of the damage and a short description of the issue. Since it concerns a replacement tied to an earlier claim, it will need additional review before another remedy is offered, so a replacement or refund would not be automatic 💖
